calibration_authority.chain: independent audit -> outer selection protocol -> control wrapper -> model protocol -> six non-target context calibration-report bindings -> report context -> digest(plan minus context_id); existing sealed manifest additionally binds plan and report.
calibration_authority.original_producer: calibrate_picorv32_latency.py:93-94 writes plain plan;116-122 verifies context digest/inputs. analyze_speedup_model.py:38-45 checks report/raw/source contracts.
calibration_authority.scope: Plan/report/context/source/input authentication and constants only; no raw calibration semantic replay or native run.

constant_fallback_source_check.classifier: isaforge/feasibility_selection.py:87-104: per-bootstrap constant0/1 if single class; consumes seed draw before branch
constant_fallback_source_check.raw: isaforge/model.py:65-67: explicit constant fallback; no confidence claim
constant_fallback_source_check.utility: isaforge/feasible_benefit.py:79-91: constant if complete replicated utility target constant

cost_accounting.caveat: The retained28 sum is not total historical acquisition cost. Frozen aggregate includes45 successes and3 failures/48 attempts, excluded rows included. Failure records were not reopened. Candidate/ledger/setup/calibration/outer observers overlap and must not be summed. No uninterrupted calendar-time or new-pool cost claim.

limitations: No MD5 candidate outcomes, excluded-row numerical fields, other candidate outcome records, full corpus or raw archive opened.
The original29-row file was hashed/framed; only exact28 records were JSON-deserialized. The excluded frame was inspected only for candidate_id.
All raw artifact hashes for exact28 candidate records checked; raw candidate simulation, stock control, netlist and three route JSONs recounted using frozen pure validators.
No compiler/simulator/synthesis/routing rerun; no complete historical chronological receipt or baseline raw-memory/correctness audit; baseline sealed contracts used.
Calibration/feature equality and successful source contracts establish input admissibility, not predictive calibration, new-pool benefit, or feasibility.
Timing/device labels all positive cannot validate negative-boundary classification or transfer.
Future complete rebuilt models/predictions/proxy bindings and controller acceptance/release remain separate gates; no dispatch authorization.

No candidate outcomes were read before v2.
